name: 404-humannotfound/php-mysql-over-ssh-tunnel
description: Framework-agnostic PHP 8.2 library that establishes or reuses an SSH local-port-forward tunnel to a remote MySQL server and exposes the local port via global constants, with graceful direct-connection fallback on environmental failures.

suggest.ext-posix: Allows reliable PID liveness checks via posix_kill(). Without it, liveness falls back to /proc inspection (Linux) or to a port-open probe, and the library may reconnect instead of reusing a fixed-port tunnel.
